input.text:
# 2D Riemann problem (configuration 3) on 120 x 120 quads with a fixed time step
# that the accelerating jet outgrows: a run to watch go unhealthy.

[run]
t_stop = 0.8
dt = 0.0019
t_wall_stop = 40.0
control_file_interval = 10

[mesh]
type = "cartesian"
Nx = 200
Ny = 200
Lx = 1.0
Ly = 1.0

[initialize]
type = "analytical"
rho = """\
    x >= 0.8 ? (y >= 0.8 ? 1.5 : 0.532258064516129) \
             : (y >= 0.8 ? 0.532258064516129 : 0.137992831541219)"""
u = [
    "x >= 0.8 ? 0.0 : 1.206045378311055",
    "y >= 0.8 ? 0.0 : 1.206045378311055",
]
p = """\
    x >= 0.8 ? (y >= 0.8 ? 1.5 : 0.3) \
             : (y >= 0.8 ? 0.3 : 0.029032258064516)"""

[[boundaries]]
name = "left"
type = "outlet_extrapolation"

[[boundaries]]
name = "right"
type = "outlet_extrapolation"

[[boundaries]]
name = "top"
type = "outlet_extrapolation"

[[boundaries]]
name = "bottom"
type = "outlet_extrapolation"

[numerics]
preset = "second_order"
check_nan = true

[physics]
type = "euler"
units = "nondimensional"
gamma = 1.4
p_ref = 1.0
T_ref = 1.0
rho_ref = 1.0

[output]
check_interval = 5

[[probes]]
name = "jet"
fields = ["RHO", "P"]
sampling = "point"
point = [0.4, 0.4]
time_interval = 0.005
file = "./solut/probe_jet.csv"

[[write_data]]
prefix = "./solut/riemann"
format = "vtu"
time_interval = 0.02
fields = ["RHO", "U_X", "U_Y", "P"]
input.resolved:
[[boundaries]]
name = "left"
type = "outlet_extrapolation"

[[boundaries]]
name = "right"
type = "outlet_extrapolation"

[[boundaries]]
name = "top"
type = "outlet_extrapolation"

[[boundaries]]
name = "bottom"
type = "outlet_extrapolation"

[initialize]
n_subdivisions = 4
p = "x >= 0.8 ? (y >= 0.8 ? 1.5 : 0.3) : (y >= 0.8 ? 0.3 : 0.029032258064516)"
rho = "x >= 0.8 ? (y >= 0.8 ? 1.5 : 0.532258064516129) : (y >= 0.8 ? 0.532258064516129 : 0.137992831541219)"
type = "analytical"
u = ["x >= 0.8 ? 0.0 : 1.206045378311055", "y >= 0.8 ? 0.0 : 1.206045378311055"]

[mesh]
Lx = 1.0
Ly = 1.0
Nx = 200
Ny = 200
cell_order = "auto"
curved_geometry = true
type = "cartesian"

[numerics]
check_nan = true
convective_flux = "riemann"
double_flux = false
low_mach_cutoff = 0.1
preset = "second_order"
riemann_solver = "RHLL"
time_integrator = "SSPRK3"

[numerics.face_reconstruction]
limiter = "venkatakrishnan"
type = "MUSCL"
venkatakrishnan_K = 5.0

[output]
async = true
check_interval = 5
divergence_report = "divergence_report"
health = true
io_threads = 1
report = "report.html"
run_log = "mallard.jsonl"
write_stencils = ""

[physics]
T_ref = 1.0
axisymmetric = false
gamma = 1.4
gas = "perfect"
p_ref = 1.0
rho_ref = 1.0
type = "euler"
units = "nondimensional"

[[probes]]
average = false
copies = "combined"
fields = ["RHO", "P"]
file = "./solut/probe_jet.csv"
format = "csv"
name = "jet"
point = [0.4, 0.4]
reductions = []
reductions_file = "probe_jet_reductions.csv"
samples = true
sampling = "point"
time_interval = 0.005
type = ""

[run]
control_file_interval = 10
control_socket = true
cuda_graphs = true
dt = 0.0019
keep_last_good = true
n_steps = 0
step_queue = 3
t_stop = 0.8
t_wall_stop = 40.0

[[write_data]]
compression = "none"
fields = ["RHO", "U_X", "U_Y", "P"]
format = "vtu"
prefix = "./solut/riemann"
time_interval = 0.02
